treatment_summary: The plan implements NICE‑recommended secondary‑prevention for post‑MI CAD: lifelong low‑dose aspirin, 12‑month clopidogrel, high‑intensity atorvastatin, ACE‑I (ramipril) and beta‑blocker (bisoprolol) titrated to target BP/HR, and dapagliflozin for renal‑cardiovascular protection. NSAIDs, pioglitazone, verapamil, diltiazem and ACE‑I/ARB combination are avoided. Monitoring of renal function, electrolytes, BP, heart rate, liver enzymes and glycaemic status is scheduled per guideline. Lifestyle measures (smoking cessation, diet, exercise, weight loss, vaccination) are also recommended.
